title: Three new Moët Hennessy roles, two at your level
intro: A good Sunday on the Moët Hennessy board: a Champagne field marketing role in New York that counts sales experience toward its 3 years, a Veuve Clicquot associate brand manager seat (a stretch on brand experience), and a Hennessy field marketing role based in Charleston. Heads up: the Youth To The People global marketing role (#3) now shows as closed.
notes: #3 Assistant Manager, Global Marketing (Youth to the People) now returns a not-found page on careers.loreal.com and no longer appears in its search results.
Moët Hennessy also posted a Sr. Manager, Trade Marketing & Specialized Channels role in New York, but it asks for 5+ years, so it isn't numbered.

Moët Hennessy's Associate Manager, People, Communications & Culture (NY) is internal communications, and its Trade CRM Specialist (NY) is Salesforce training and sales operations, so neither is numbered.
SMCP Group: Greenhouse still shows NY corporate (AR Coordinator, Allocation Planner Maje) and retail only, with no US marketing, brand, or partnerships roles.
L'Oréal USA's newest US postings since yesterday are retail, operations, and sales roles, with no new marketing fits.
L'Occitane's North America board is unchanged (retail plus the contract TikTok and education roles).

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Field Marketing – Champagne & Sparkling (NYC)
jobs.work_arrangement: 3 days a week in the NYC office, plus in market as the business needs
jobs.posted_extra: still open; new to your list today
jobs.french_tie: Moët Hennessy (LVMH, Paris HQ); the role runs local programming for the Champagne & Sparkling portfolio, with a focus on Prestige Champagnes.
jobs.why: Localizing Champagne brand programming in NYC: flagship activations, winemaker visits, trade dinners, and building relationships with sommeliers, distributors, and accounts. It's relationship-heavy brand work that suits your AE background.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3+ years in field, trade, or brand marketing, sales, or a related commercial role, so your Gartner years count.

jobs.title: Associate Brand Manager, Veuve Clicquot
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid, 3 days a week in the NYC office
jobs.french_tie: Veuve Clicquot is a Champagne Maison of Moët Hennessy (LVMH, Paris HQ); the role works with the Maison brand team.
jobs.why: A true brand management seat: 360 marketing programs and activations, brand-owned channels like CRM and the brand site, A&P budget tracking, and annual brand planning for a famous French Champagne house.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–5 years of progressive brand marketing or experiential management in luxury, wine & spirits, or a similar category.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Field Marketing, Hennessy (SC, NC & LA)
jobs.location: Charleston, SC (must live in the Charleston metro area)
jobs.french_tie: Hennessy is a Cognac house in France; Moët Hennessy is part of LVMH (Paris HQ).
jobs.travel: Substantial in-market travel across South Carolina, plus travel to North Carolina and Louisiana; Paris is not mentioned
jobs.why: Hands-on brand programming and partnerships with key accounts, cultural organizations, community leaders, and influencers. Your level fits, but it's far from LA.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3+ years in field, trade, or brand marketing, sales, or a related commercial role; the catch is the Charleston location.

jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager, Redken US (Hair Color)
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Redken is in the Professional Products Division.
jobs.travel: Domestic travel periodically, up to 25%; posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: Still open, and still the most realistic-level L'Oréal role from this week (1–3 years required).

jobs.title: Manager, Advocacy and Influence — Biolage
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home), per the posting
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Biolage is in the Professional Products Division.
jobs.travel: Domestic travel periodically (25%); posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: Still open: creator and agency partnerships for Biolage.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 4–6 years in marketing, branding, or product management.
